clue.text: Oversea wear? You might say that!

definitions.text: Oversea wear? You might say that!

parts.words: Oversea wear? You might say that!
parts.note: read 'oversea' as over the sea itself: clothing worn while floating on the waves, not on a trip abroad

explanation.surface: Someone joking about what to pack for a holiday abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Oversea' pretends to mean overseas travel; the garment is worn right on top of the sea, by a bather.
explanation.definitionFit: Bathing shorts are what a man wears when he is out in the sea, literally over the water.

clue.text: Unearthly game?

parts.note: unearthly is read as not on earth, played in a pool rather than on land, not as supernatural

explanation.definitionFit: A ball sport played by swimmers in a pool takes place off dry land entirely.

clue.text: A poetic region can produce bad feeling

indicators.note: letters that can produce something are reworked into a new arrangement here

parts.note: clime is a literary or poetic word for a region or climate

explanation.surface: A remark that verse about some place can stir up resentment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can produce' rearranges A plus CLIME into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Spite or ill will towards someone is a bad feeling held against them.

clue.text: Small measure for part of the fish

definitions.meaning: a quarter-pint liquid measure in imperial units
the breathing organ of a fish

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a small imperial liquid measure and a fish's breathing organ.

clue.text: Blows men up in the Armed Forces!

definitions.text: Blows men up in the Armed Forces!

parts.words: Blows men up in the Armed Forces!
parts.note: 'blows up' means wakes by a bugle call, not explodes

explanation.surface: A shocking report of explosions among servicemen.
explanation.definitionFit: The early-morning bugle call in barracks rouses sleeping soldiers from their beds.

clue.text: Birth place?

parts.note: an adjective meaning relating to birth that is also the name of a South African province

explanation.definitionFit: The word describes birth and is also a former province of South Africa, a real place.

clue.text: Fieldwork for the soldier?

parts.note: work in the field of combat, not research done outdoors

explanation.definitionFit: Combat on a battlefield is the work a soldier does in the field.

clue.text: Invalid reason for wanting EC 4 P such transport

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Invalid reason for wanting EC 4 P such transport': the 'EC 4 P' fragment fits no parse of the answer and looks like an OCR garble
annotationWithheld.clue: Invalid reason for wanting EC 4 P such transport

clue.text: Lifts vast eastern fish, long and wriggling

indicators.note: something wriggling twists about, so these letters are mixed up

parts.note: the eel is a long snake-like fish

explanation.surface: A fisherman hauls up a huge, squirming eastern catch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wriggling' rearranges VAST, E and EEL together; 'and' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise something is to lift it to a higher position.

clue.text: All rate being knocked sideways

indicators.note: letters being knocked about are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Every price is battered from the side.
explanation.definitionFit: Lateral movement goes to the side rather than forwards, i.e. sideways.

clue.text: Suggests revolutionary wear for a betrayer of the cause!

parts.note: turning is revolving, so 'revolutionary' suggests turn
a coat is an item of wear

explanation.surface: Clothing for a radical marks someone who switches sides.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who deserts their party or principles for the other side betrays the cause.

clue.text: Stone thrown up, as it were, which shouldn't come down!

definitions.text: Stone thrown up, as it were, which shouldn't come down!

parts.words: Stone thrown up, as it were, which shouldn't come down!
parts.note: 'thrown up' means erected, a stone column built to stand, not a stone tossed in the air

explanation.surface: A stone flung upward that ought to stay aloft.
explanation.definitionFit: An upright stone column is built to support a structure and must stay standing.

clue.text: Highly thought of having paid proper attention to others' beliefs

definitions.text: having paid proper attention to others' beliefs
definitions.meaning: past tense of showing due regard for other people's views

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an adjective for esteemed and the past tense of showing due regard.

clue.text: One not working with a union-basher, so to speak

definitions.meaning: a worker who has downed tools in a dispute
a hitter or basher who belongs to a union

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a worker taking industrial action and one who hits things.

clue.text: Exult over the bird

definitions.meaning: a large black bird of the genus Corvus

explanation.definitionFit: The word means to gloat triumphantly and also names a black corvid bird.

clue.text: Criminal flair?

explanation.definitionFit: The word is slang for corrupt and also means a natural aptitude or leaning.

clue.text: Doesn't have a soft term, we hear

indicators.note: what we hear is spoken, so a word with the same sound is meant

parts.note: lax is a term meaning soft or slack

explanation.surface: Someone who cannot find a gentle word to use.
explanation.definitionFit: To be without something is to be short of it or missing it.

clue.text: Saw plane trees all for him!

definitions.text: Saw plane trees all for him!

parts.words: Saw plane trees all for him!
parts.note: saw and plane are woodworking tools and trees give timber, all the stuff of a woodworker's trade

explanation.surface: Someone spotting a row of plane trees in the park.
explanation.definitionFit: A woodworker uses saws and planes on timber from trees.

clue.text: New formula means oil can be used to make food

indicators.note: a new formula for the letters means arranging them afresh

explanation.surface: A recipe change lets oil be used in cooking a dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can be used to make' only links the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The coarse wheat grains used for puddings and pasta are a food.

clue.text: Almost all have one quite separate from others

indicators.note: almost the whole word means its last letter is dropped

explanation.surface: Nearly everyone owns one, yet stands apart.
explanation.definitionFit: Being by oneself means being apart from everyone else.

clue.text: It's dry and in great fear, idiomatically speaking

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'It's dry and in great fear, idiomatically speaking': no sound or word for 'in great fear' plainly gives the letters, so the second half cannot be parsed honestly
annotationWithheld.clue: It's dry and in great fear, idiomatically speaking

clue.text: It's priceless-priceless to be so, indeed

definitions.text: It's priceless-priceless to be so, indeed

parts.words: It's priceless-priceless to be so, indeed
parts.note: priceless read as having no price, and also as wonderful: being at liberty is invaluable

explanation.definitionFit: Something given at no charge has no price, and liberty itself is beyond price.

clue.text: Not quite the appropriate word for it

definitions.text: Not quite the appropriate word for it

parts.words: Not quite the appropriate word for it
parts.note: the clue's opening words are themselves a meaning of the word sought

explanation.definitionFit: Nearly but not entirely is exactly the sense of the word, so it describes itself.

clue.text: Estimate, I suppose

definitions.meaning: said in speech as 'I think so'

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to calculate roughly and also to think or suppose.

clue.text: Scots long to get the first cuckoo before it can make a ringing sound

indicators.note: one piece placed before another sits ahead of it in the answer
the first of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: lang is the Scots form of long

explanation.surface: A Scot waits for spring's first cuckoo call.
explanation.definitionFit: A loud metallic noise is a ringing sound like a struck bell.

clue.text: Ring from this temporary accommodation?

parts.note: ring suggests a bell and temporary accommodation a tent, a shelter shaped like a bell

explanation.definitionFit: A conical camping shelter shaped like a bell is temporary accommodation.

clue.text: Boil one on the lid

parts.note: the lid is the eyelid, not a pan lid, and the boil is an inflamed swelling, not cooking

explanation.definitionFit: An inflamed swelling on the edge of an eyelid is a small boil.

clue.text: Genuine sort of people?

parts.note: people of the real kind, i.e. those who face facts as they are

explanation.definitionFit: Practical people who see things as they really are are the down-to-earth type.

clue.text: On such a line we generally make our name!

definitions.text: On such a line we generally make our name!

parts.words: On such a line we generally make our name!
parts.note: 'make our name' read literally as signing on a form, not becoming famous

explanation.definitionFit: Forms mark the place for a signature with a line of dots.

clue.text: Sportsmen in search of the Cup Final, or Test, maybe

definitions.text: Sportsmen in search of the Cup Final, or Test, maybe

parts.words: Sportsmen in search of the Cup Final, or Test, maybe
parts.note: the big games are not football or cricket matches but large wild animals pursued by hunters

explanation.definitionFit: Hunters who stalk large wild animals pursue the biggest quarry there is.
